name: Going to The Gong 2020
information:
We are pleased to be hosting the first ever WCA competition in Wollongong! The competition will run from 9 am to 5 pm.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
